content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: BIOC(CDR-010 Container chroot to Host Filesystem Mount) AND XQL(CDR-010 In-Container Mass File Encryption Rate) — fuses the container-to-host escape with the in-container mass-encrypt rate into a single container-ransomware incident.
rules.name: Container-Native Ransomware — Host Escape Then Encrypt Impact
